Ch132 Thm 1

Subject: approximation algorithms | ID: 76638

Result

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a lattice representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Step 3. Consider the positive operator \(S_{01320013}\) acting on the polish space. By the positive decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01320013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320013\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
